- A‑X1 = 16.364 Ω  
- X1‑N_b1 = 5 Ω (A‑N_b1 = 16.364 + 5 = 21.364)  
- N_b1‑N_b2 = 10 Ω (A‑N_b2 = 16.364 + 5 + 10 = 31.364)  
- N_b2‑N_b3 = 15 Ω (A‑N_b3 = 16.364 + 5 + 10 + 15 = 46.364)  
- N_b3‑B = 20 Ω (A‑B = 16.364 + 5 + 10 + 15 + 20 = 66.364)

All other pairwise resistances are sums of the appropriate consecutive segments, matching the provided data exactly. Hence the circuit is a simple series chain with five resistors labeled from left to right as R1…R5.</thought>
